title: They Are Coming for Your Super
body:
As I've long thought, the government is eyeing off our super.
https://archive.md/2026.07.14-192619/https://www.afr.com/com…
Albo wants super to be considered a "national asset".
Keating wants super to be entwined with Centrelink.
CGT discount rule changes have probably pushed some people from investing their money in shares/property etc into super instead.
Will this sort of rhetoric change anyone's mind about extra super contributions, or setting up a SMSF?
